description: This script generates a FIT (Flattened Image Tree) configuration file (.its) for U-Boot firmware, enabling booting of Linux kernels and associated components as FIT images. It processes input parameters, includes device tree blobs, initrd, root filesystem, overlays, and creates a detailed device tree source file.
external_files: DTB files provided via command-line parameters

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script, outlining available options and their purposes.

methods.name: check_required_params
methods.description: Validates that all mandatory parameters are provided before proceeding with FIT file generation.
